correctness.rationale: For every m>=2 the proof derives exact terminal flux constraints d=(p-pfinal-Z-3Y)/2 and proves each designated exception cannot stack at hub or any leaf. Conversely B=s+sum floor(leaf/2), T=2B-s+r, and a free-elimination classification exhaustively clear every other critical configuration. originality.rationale: Novelty is strictly the exhaustive single-orbit critical obstruction theorem, not the pre-existing threshold stack=clear=4m or the previously known example sharp obstruction. The original paper gives general and multipartite values, while the closest earlier friendship-graph manuscript gives the threshold plus a representative witness but not the absence of all other failures. The full critical-layer uniqueness is not a corollary of scalar values or existence of one witness. Search and source access limitations are documented.
